title: Ops Pilot
description: Internal copiloted operations workspace for support and fulfillment teams.
longDescription: We implemented an AI-assisted operations console that reduced repetitive manual triage and improved first-response speed.
challenge: Operations agents were context switching across tools and spending too much time on repetitive issue triage.
solution: We built a single workspace with AI-generated draft actions, confidence indicators, and guardrails for escalation.

slides.title: Discovery
slides.description: Captured high-volume task patterns and escalation causes.

slides.title: Interaction Model
slides.description: Designed assisted actions with explicit approval checkpoints.

slides.title: Delivery
slides.description: Implemented tool orchestration and safety telemetry.

slides.title: Adoption
slides.description: Rolled out playbooks and measured utilization by team.
